description: This file defines a class 'SimpleGeofenceStore' that manages storage of geofence objects using Android's SharedPreferences. It provides methods to save, retrieve, and delete geofence data, encapsulating geofence attributes such as latitude, longitude, radius, expiration duration, and transition type.

classes.name: SimpleGeofenceStore
classes.description: A class that handles persisting geofence data in SharedPreferences, allowing geofences to be stored, retrieved, and cleared by ID.

methods.name: SimpleGeofenceStore
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SharedPreferences storage with private mode.

methods.name: getGeofence
methods.description: Retrieves a stored geofence by its ID, returning a SimpleGeofence object if all attributes are valid, or null otherwise.

methods.name: setGeofence
methods.description: Stores the attributes of a SimpleGeofence in SharedPreferences under a generated key.

methods.name: clearGeofence
methods.description: Removes all stored entries for a specific geofence ID from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: getGeofenceFieldKey
methods.description: Generates the key name for a specific geofence attribute based on its ID and the attribute's key.
